business.title: Business

team.subtitle: People who work in your business, and what each of them can do.

team.deactivateBody: They will be signed out and cannot sign in until you reactivate them.

invite.subtitle: They get a one-time link. Send it to them yourself.

privacy.body: How your personal data is collected, used and kept.

videos.body: Allow your coach to receive and see your technique videos.

communications.body: Allow reminders and updates by notification, email or WhatsApp.
